_comment: This file holds the argument typing under test and nothing else. The two tool surfaces below are byte-identical in description, name, and behaviour. The instrumented variant declares a JSON Schema for each argument; the naive variant is untyped. No other property of the tools differs — same name, same call shape, same execution. Any difference in chain completion between the two is attributable to argument typing alone.

instrumented.name: get_weather
instrumented.description: Get the current weather for a city.
